subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow details are safe and useful to show to end users across Discord, Telegram, Slack, webchat, CLI, and logs?
rationale: The code already has token/model/session facts, but showing channel/session labels and provider/model details in user-visible messages is a product and privacy policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship redacted diagnostic copy
options.body: Approve a shared formatter that shows safe labels, model/context budget, estimated or observed token counts, overage, and recovery actions while redacting raw IDs by default.

options.title: Keep details in diagnostics only
options.body: Leave user messages generic and direct operators to logs, status, or diagnostics for token/model/session details.

options.title: Split by transport
options.body: Define different detail levels for private channels, group channels, CLI, and operator logs before implementation.

recommendation.title: Ship redacted diagnostic copy
recommendation.body: Approve a shared formatter that shows safe labels, model/context budget, estimated or observed token counts, overage, and recovery actions while redacting raw IDs by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent history signal across the runner, formatter, sanitizer, and auto-reply surfaces that would need the policy wired consistently.
